Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with
cervical whiplash. Over the course of 28 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, manual
therapy, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency tapering as
smyptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly
confirm soft-tissue injury to the cervical spine. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none
is documented in available records. Whether the current presentation is entirely attributable to this collision remains
unclear and will require further review of the causation history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service
with no repeated or duplicate entries. Patient was discharged from active care with a home program and instructions
to return if symptoms recur.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
